text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон has managed to leave
quite a mark
on the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: One afternoon...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm comin' in, Teach. Have you had lunch
yet?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I've made us boxed lunches. Wanna eat
them
together?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And with that, I join Хиши Амадзон for
lunch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Havin' lunch under a blue sky sure is
great.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the burdock root is nice and salty,
and it
was a good choice to make the
rolled omelet
sweeter.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
The lunch she's packed is a true hallmark
of her
attention to detail. It's
nutritionally balanced and
brimming with
care.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Feeling some tea, Teach? I've got some
piping
hot and ready to go here.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I take in the calm, relaxing atmosphere...
but I
can't maintain my zen because of a
small,
persistent question in the back of
my mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон's not the type to idle the
time away
for the fun of it, so maybe
there's something she
wants to discuss
with me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh? No, not at all. Why do you ask?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She looks at me in confusion. I try to
explain my
train of thought, but when I
do...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hahaha! What are you goin' on about?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
There isn't anything special behind this.

Sometimes I just want to take things
slow.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I first started
running with
you.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And there's still much more running to
do. More
crying, more laughing, more
winning, and more
losing too...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Things are definitely going to be
chaotic. But
that's just how we roll.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That's why I thought it'd be nice to take
time out
to do nothin' but chill now and
again.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
This is just a little break. Nothing more.
Anyway,
here.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: She hands me some hot tea.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'll be counting on you for the long run,
Teach.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I take a sip of tea, and the gentle flavor
warms
me to the core.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so begins the next leg of my
journey with
Hishi Amazon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
